description: This file defines the ReturnReason controller class within the Opencart Admin namespace, which adds a task to generate a list of return reasons during certain events in the Opencart system.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class that adds a task to generate a list of return reasons when certain events are triggered.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles event hooks to add a task for generating return reason list; it loads the task model and adds a specific task with predefined data.
